insights.one_liner: Dyflexis makes workforce scheduling software used from local bakeries to hotel chains, from The Hague, and is an IND-recognised sponsor.

culture.text: Its workforce management software is used by millions of employees, from small shops to international hotel and retail chains.
Postings say customer questions are varied and no two days are the same.

open.text: Dyflexis B.V. is an IND recognised sponsor.

growth.text: The company says its product is growing rapidly in more than 20 countries.
